name: JMC Manufacturing Co
old_description: For five decades, JMC Wood Manufacturing has built its reputation on providing high-quality wood lamination and fabricated part solutions to its customers. Over the years, we’ve developed an impressive array of manufacturing resources.  But the heart of our operation is the extra attention and service we give our customers.  The following is a summary of JMC’s services and capabilities:
about:
JMC Wood Manufacturing operates from Bridgeton, Missouri. The company has served customers for five decades, though a precise founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in available sources.

The shop specializes in wood lamination and fabricated parts, running a broad lineup of equipment that includes seven CNC routers, two CNC panel saws with a 61-by-145-inch sheet capacity, an eight-foot-wide seven-head miter-fold machine, eight-head and seven-head molders, straight-line and contour edge banders (including an IMA unit for 4x10 tops), and high-speed boring stations. Proprietary adhesive systems — KissCoat, PopFree, HPBond, PressFit, and WRAPtight PUR — handle vinyls, papers, HPL, FRP, aluminum, and other overlays on substrates such as particleboard, plywood, MDF, and gypsum.

Customers include building-products firms such as PortaKing Building Products, referenced in company materials. The operation serves any market requiring laminated panels, profile-wrapped moldings, miter-folded components, edge-banded parts, or precision-cut blanks.

JMC emphasizes its full-range in-house capabilities and proprietary gluing formulas as differentiators, stating that few competitors match the breadth of its woodworking and lamination equipment under one roof.
